text:
alex-newhire: hi folks, first day Q about Notion/setup. SSO worked but i can't find the onboarding docs or the team runbooks. where should i look and how do i get edit access if i need to contribute?

devex-jules: welcome! onboarding checklist lives in /Company Templates/Onboarding (link: https://redwood.notion.so/company-onboarding). team runbooks live under each team in /Team Docs — for infra it's /Team Docs/Engineering/Infra/Runbooks. If you only see View, you're probably a Limited Member.

alex-newhire: got it. i also tried to use a template i found in a search but the "Template" button wasn't there on that page. is that expected?

ops-liaison: yes — the Template button is only present on pages published inside the /Templates/* spaces and when you have Editor rights. Search can show regular pages that were used as sources, but the official, instantiable templates are in /Templates/engineering or /Templates/product depending on the team.

alex-newhire: ok. workflow question: where should I draft something (e.g., a short onboarding checklist) before asking maintainers to publish it as a template?

devex-jules: draft first in My Pages. When ready, run `@doc-bot new-template <notion-link> short-summary` in Slack to request a template review. Maintainers will check page properties (Owner, Template Owner, Status, Tags) and link hygiene, then publish into /Templates/engineering. Don’t move drafts directly into the Templates space.

alex-newhire: what's the naming convention for runbooks/templates? i usually do kebab-case but happy to follow company style.

ops-liaison: for discoverability we prefer a human title with the team prefix, e.g. `eng-infra - New hire checklist - 2026-03`. Also add a slug property like `eng-infra/new-hire-checklist` and set `Status: Draft` while it's being reviewed. In My Pages kebab-case is fine for personal notes.

alex-newhire: if i need to iterate quickly with reviewers, can i get temporary edit access to the Team Docs folder?

doc-bot: To request temporary edit rights: `@doc-bot request-access /Team Docs/Engineering reason:"template iteration"` — editors are typically granted for 7 days; include justification for longer windows.

devex-jules: small tip: include a short "Why" paragraph at the top of the page (who uses this, when to use it) and add `Tags: onboarding, new-hire, infra` so search surfaces it. Also ping the template owners listed on /Templates/engineering after filing the bot request.

alex-newhire: perfect — i'll draft in My Pages and file the bot request when it's ready. thanks everyone! :wave:

(reacted with :thumbsup: by devex-jules)
